What We Do

One bag. One life changed.

Every GGS POV care bag is assembled by hand with love and distributed directly to individuals experiencing unhousedness — in South Florida and beyond.

🎒

Hygiene Care Bags

Soap, shampoo, deodorant, toothbrush, feminine products, socks, underwear, food — every bag assembled by hand and delivered with love and dignity.

🌍

Global Vision

We currently serve the unhoused community in South Florida but hope to grow to distribute these impactful GG bags throughout the United States and one day across the world!

🙏

Faith in Action

Rooted in faith, driven by compassion. Every bag is prepared with prayer and the belief that every human life has infinite worth and dignity.

Our Story

It started with a quiet calling.

For years, founder Heidi Gonzalez assembled hygiene bags for unhoused women and men — not for recognition, not for reward, but as a private act of faith. No cameras. No followers. Just love in action. Today, GGS POV, Inc. is formalizing that mission to grow its impact — inviting the world to join in God's work, one bag at a time.

Since 2019, over 288 hygiene care bags have been distributed directly into the hands of unhoused women and men — and the number grows every month. Each bag is assembled by hand and delivered with love, because every single person deserves to be seen, valued, and treated with dignity.

Every bag represents a life touched. Every distribution is a moment of human connection. Every item inside is a reminder that someone cares — and that God's love is real, visible, and on the move. 🧡

Our Journey

Six Years of Love in Action

What started as a quiet act of faith at a stoplight has grown into a monthly mission of dignity and compassion.

📅

Since 2019

GGS POV has been assembling and distributing care bags every single month since 2019 — rain or shine, quietly and faithfully serving the unhoused community in South Florida.

🎒

288+ Bags & Counting

Over 288 hygiene care bags have been distributed directly into the hands of unhoused women and men — and the number grows every month. Every single bag represents a life touched with dignity and love.

💬

Built by Their Voices

While offering bags at stoplights, Heidi has had 30-second conversations with the people she serves — listening to what they truly need. The bags started with 5 basic items and now contain over 20. New items are always added when requested, because every voice matters.
